meta.name: account-selection
meta.description: ABM account selection framework for building, scoring, staging, and managing target account lists. Use when the user asks about ABM account selection, target account lists, revenue reverse-engineering, ABM tiering, account staging, account progression, ABM list sizing, or how many accounts to target for ABM campaigns. Triggers on "account selection", "ABM accounts", "target account list", "how many accounts", "ABM tier", "account staging", "account progression", "revenue target", "ABM list", "stage conversion", "identified to aware", "account scoring ABM". Do NOT use for general ICP definition without ABM context (use define-icp) or LinkedIn ad targeting (use linkedin-ads skill).

copy.tagline: 构建并管理目标账户列表用于ABM营销
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为基于客户的营销活动筛选和分级目标企业账户
copy.tagline_en: Build and manage target account lists for ABM campaigns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to select and tier target accounts for account-based marketing

howto.what: Claude 会依据收入目标反向推导所需账户数，用4层筛选标准（企业画像、技术栈等）给账户打分（0-100）并分A/B/C/D级，还能跟踪账户从认知到考虑各阶段的进展。
howto.when: 当你询问 ABM 账户选择、目标账户列表、收入逆向工程、ABM 分层、账户阶段或账户进展时触发。

say.text: 我需要多少账户来做 ABM 活动？
say.note: 你会收到基于收入目标的账户数量估算。

say.text: 如何给我的账户列表进行分层？
say.note: 你会得到按评分划分的 A/B/C/D 层级。

howto.what_en: Claude helps build, score, stage, and manage target account lists for ABM. It reverse-engineers account count from revenue goals, applies 4-layer criteria (firmographic, technographic, etc.), scores accounts 0-100, assigns tiers (A/B/C/D), and tracks stage progression.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about ABM account selection, target account lists, revenue reverse-engineering, account tiering, staging, progression, or list sizing.

say_en.text: How many accounts do I need for my ABM campaign?
say_en.note: You will receive an account count estimate based on revenue targets.

say_en.text: How do I tier my account list?
say_en.note: You will get A/B/C/D tiers based on scoring.

say_en.text: How do I track account progression?
say_en.note: You will learn stage tracking via LinkedIn and HubSpot.
